decisionSemantics.keep: Final minimal model retains a demonstrated access boundary
decisionSemantics.replace: Migrate to exact governed target(s); remove old active permission identity
decisionSemantics.remove: Eliminate old active permission; migrate the business operation to scoped parent/self authority or a reviewed successor
decisionSemantics.review_required: No final disposition yet; never interpreted as keep, omit or allow; prevents claiming cleanup complete

implementationGates: Inventory active source/profile/compiler/API/UI/policy/grant/catalog/provisioning consumers and all target planes.
Implement missing capability in existing shared Entity Framework; no parallel routes/providers or entity-name permission dispatch.
Validate exact optional permission properties and locked self/parent/tenant scope on all entry points.
Resolve explicit denies and actor/scope changes before replacing grants; no blanket grants, source-code aliases or permissive fallback.
Independently reviewed publication and target evidence before active cutover.
Remove obsolete active definitions and regeneration inputs; immutable historical releases/migrations remain evidence only.
Verify clean rebuild plus authorized and denied user flows under agreed testing scope; runtime verification remains pending.
